coordinateSystem.origin: inside corner where the corridor wall meets the left-hand wall as you walk in
coordinateSystem.x: to the right as you walk in, 0 to 6.5
coordinateSystem.z: up from the finished floor of the unit
coordinateSystem.roomBounds: room rectangles use the notes' lines. Interior partitions are centred on those lines; exterior walls sit outside the 6.5 x 10.0 box, so the box is the inside dimension
coordinateSystem.rotation: rotationDeg is counter-clockwise seen from above. 0 = the object's front faces +y (the windows), 90 = faces -x, 180 = faces -y (the corridor), 270 = faces +x
coordinateSystem.toThreeJs: three.x = x, three.y = z, three.z = -y. A plan rotation of r degrees becomes object.rotation.y = r * PI / 180
coordinateSystem.compassFromPlan: bearing (degrees clockwise from true north) of a plan direction (dx, dy) = 135 + atan2(dx, dy) in degrees. So +y = 135 (SE), +x = 225 (SW), -x = 45 (NE), -y = 315 (NW)
coordinateSystem.planFromCompass: for bearing B and distance d measured from the centre of the window wall (3.25, 10.0): t = B - 135; x = 3.25 + d*sin(t); y = 10.0 + d*cos(t)

facing.which: the window wall (y = 10.0) faces south-east; the corridor wall faces north-west

site.sunNotes: computed from the latitude: on 18 Jun 2026 sunrise 05:56, solar noon 13:58, sunset 22:01 (clock time). Direct sun enters the glass from about 06:00 (low, from the left) until about 15:45. On 7 Nov 2026 the sun is low (max 25 deg) and in the glass from sunrise 07:53 until about 15:00.
